greeting.speaker: npc
greeting.text: Careful with your elbows. Half of this stall came over the pass on a mule that did not want to.

offer.speaker: npc
offer.text: The ring? Riverglass, cut inland. Sixty silver, and I am robbing myself.

choices.text: Forty. We both know what riverglass goes for.
Twenty, and I don't mention where the mule came from.
You held one back for me last market day.

haggle_soft.speaker: npc
haggle_soft.text: Forty-five. I have a daughter and she eats like two.

choices.text: Then I'll leave it on the cloth.

haggle_hard.speaker: npc
haggle_hard.text: ...Thirty. And you will say nothing about mules, ever, to anyone.

choices.text: On reflection, I'll pay the sixty.

reserved_stock.speaker: npc
reserved_stock.text: So I did. Under the cloth, and do not make a face — it is better than the one on the table.

buy_full.speaker: npc
buy_full.text: A person who does not argue. I will remember you kindly.

buy_discount.speaker: npc
buy_discount.text: Forty-five. Take it before I count again.

leave.speaker: npc
leave.text: It will be here. Or it will not.
